reference_recording.result: Successful actual v688 offscreen Qt recording through serialized with-oracle on a fresh basic fixture, with PNG inspected and clean client shutdown. Five real DuplicatesPanel input/save/serialization/reopen cases preserve None and clamp 0/10 to 1/9; an abandoned page does not save. Real CanvasFilterDuplicates over transparent PNG A and opaque JPEG B uses its own ordered factory, IsShowingFileA and SwitchMedia. Its actual colour generator records 143 base/intensity results, including black, brightness threshold, saturation overflow and coloured backgrounds. Actual StaticImage._DrawBackground records eight A/B background/checker/greenscreen outcomes. No business colour functions, canvas handlers, media or relationship content are replaced/written. The sandbox denied unrelated local Client API bind; recording and shutdown completed.
